'''Darth Krayt's War Room''' was a room inside the [[Temple of the Sith]] on [[One Sith|Sith]]&ndash;[[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]]-held [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Prior to [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attacking]] the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi's]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]] invited [[High Moff]] [[Morlish Veed]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Geist (Moff)|Geist]], and [[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro]] to the War Room and held a council of war.
